snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5155060/Mise_en_War/

Mise en war, a cooking brawl born from kitchen discipline but fueled by chaos. In this kitchen, the only thing that stays in place will be your friends’ anger towards you.
